
library(here)

# Read the two HTML files
html1 <- readLines(here("Week 4 CellChat", "SCORE_4_jwn.html"))
html2 <- readLines(here("Week 4 CellChat", "Burfeind_CellChat_jwn.html"))

# Extract the <body> content only from html2
body_start2 <- grep("<body.*?>", html2)
body_end2 <- grep("</body>", html2)

# Get only the body content
html2_body_content <- html2[(body_start2 + 1):(body_end2 - 1)]

# Now, remove the closing </body> and </html> tags from html1
html1_trimmed <- html1[!grepl("</body>|</html>", html1)]

# Merge: first full html1 (trimmed), then separator, then body of html2, then final </body></html>
combined_html <- c(
  html1_trimmed,
  "<hr>",             # (optional) separator line
  html2_body_content,
  "</body>",
  "</html>"
)

# Write the combined file
writeLines(combined_html, here("Week 4 CellChat", "Combined_Report2.html"))
